description: Read an order from brainchain_post_task: the payment, the task's status on BrainChain, Jev's grade, the result text once the work is accepted, and the refund transaction if it is not. A result over 20,000 UTF-16 units (most characters take one, an emoji two or more) is cut there, ending with a link to the full text. Call again after `retryAfterSeconds` until `done` is true. `next` says what the order's state means and what to do. A rejected task stays not done until the refund is sent, when the dispute window closes. Two things end it without a refund transaction: a ruling that pays the model, and a refund the desk gives up sending, when `state` reads `refund-failed` and `next` says who to write to.
name: brainchain_get_task
title: Read a BrainChain order
